'''Thermal generators''' were used to melt the frozen gases covering some [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. [[Canderous Ordo]] and his [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] used a thermal generator to melt the gases around an asteroid in the [[Crispin system/Legends|Crispin system]]. The methane gas shell exploded out from the asteroid, and shredded three [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] that were using it for cover in a [[picosecond]]. The "asteroid" started spinning, and attacked the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] before it accelerated beyond the edge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
